title: ticket writes: single guarded path — rewrite SKILL/CLAUDE workflow steps to MCP tools, arm the board close guard, enforce uat_delegated on uat-only loop closes (R4 + R5 guard leg)
description: Deep-review sweep #2 (2026-07-06) HIGH finding R4 (F23+F16) plus the guard leg of R5 (F4), adversarially confirmed. Three canonical prose sites still instruct direct guard-bypassing Edit-to-done — orchestrator-routing SKILL.md:88-90, :97, Workflow step 6 (:138-141), and CLAUDE.md Workflow step 7 (CLAUDE.md never mentions the MCP tools) — contradicting the Ticket-update protocol (SKILL.md:613-617) that exists precisely because hand edits bypass the uat-only done-guard and loop-mode close guard (TASK-082). The third write path half-enforces: src/task-board.js:1370 calls transitionStatus WITHOUT closeGuard, unlike src/mcp-server.js:185,230, so a board POST closes a ticket ignoring auto_close_on_green_review (SKILL.md:616 falsely claims MCP is the 'only' path). And Gate 2 is prose-only: checkUatGuard (src/task-store.js:377) accepts ANY comment authored 'uat' — no code reads uat_delegated_to_orchestrator, so a drifting model with only auto_close granted can self-author a uat comment and close a uat-only ticket past both shipped guards, contradicting SKILL.md:440-444. Full context: synthesis §R4 + §R5.
acceptance_criteria: Both orchestrator-routing SKILL.md copies (Workflow step 6, :88-97 region, Ticket-update protocol) and CLAUDE.md Workflow step 7 name close_task/transition_status/append_comment as THE write path, with direct Edit demoted to an explicitly-labeled degraded fallback — no canonical step instructs a direct Edit-to-done anymore.
A doc-lock spec asserts the Workflow step text in both SKILL.md copies and CLAUDE.md references the MCP close_task tool (rot-proofing the rewrite).

src/task-board.js's transitionStatus call passes closeGuard: loopModeCloseGuard — red-first spec proving a board POST to done in loop mode without auto_close_on_green_review is currently accepted, then rejected.

The close guard is extended for Gate 2: in loop mode, closing a verification_tier uat-only ticket additionally requires loop_auth.uat_delegated_to_orchestrator===true (or the uat comment records an explicit human verdict marker); typed error; red-first spec.
SKILL.md's 'only path that runs the guards' claim (:616 region) is corrected to match post-fix reality (MCP tools + guarded board endpoint).
